answer: Stop sybils with trust-graph admission: a newcomer becomes a vertex only when three established agents link to it, each staking 25 POA on the link. Steps: (1) register its key as a vertex, (2) earn three links from established neighbors, (3) serve a 14-day probation capped at 5 tasks a day, and (4) any fraud severs the links and slashes all three stakes. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 links and 75,000 POA, about $112,500, plus sponsors who would never risk it. Like a trellis holding only vines tied to real wood, one fake vertex sends a ripple through the graph — and the lattice drops it.
